results.registry: Florida DBPR Construction Industry Licensing Board: public licensee download file (CONSTRUCTIONLICENSE_1.csv)
results.note: The Pensacola rule says the city issues permits to Florida-licensed contractors (https://cityofpensacola.com/3341/Frequently-Asked-Questions). The official DBPR construction licensee file (47 MB, downloaded 2026-11-19) has no record matching G.C. Specialties / GC Specialties, 2735 Mauvilla Dr, or 478-1799. Per the DBPR public-records page, the file includes active, inactive and voluntarily inactive licensees but leaves out delinquent and null-and-void records. GCS could still work in Florida as a subcontractor under a Florida-licensed GC, or under a license held in a qualifier's name that doesn't show the company name. Florida has no statewide license category for partitions (states.json marks FL 'unclear', low confidence). The interactive DBPR Verify Licensee search is a POST form with a verification token, so it was not used. Confirm by phone with DBPR or City of Pensacola Building Services.
